Oneliner

Collect environmental data in hard-to-reach regions, communicating with strategically positioned ground-based data collection platforms
Description

Mission is to collect environmental data in hard-to-reach regions, communicating with strategically positioned ground-based data collection platforms in the Alcântara region, expanding the capacity to monitor the territory of Maranhão in near real-time.
Developed by the Federal University of Maranhão (UFMA) in partnership with startups and national institutions.
Bizu Space was selected by @ufmaoficialto provide the BizuPOD, the deployer system that will be responsible for releasing the Jussara-K satellite into orbit: a mission in partnership with CRON Sistemas e Tecnologias.
